cohort: 223 singleton term pregnancies delivered by cesarean section
finding: In term cesarean sections, neonatal hematocrit is significantly higher when the cesarean section is performed in labor or with umbilical cord milking.
mod_finding: In elective cesarean sections, umbilical cord milking led to higher neonatal hematocrit compared to early umbilical cord clamping without milking and delayed umbilical cord clamping, while in cesarean sections performed in labor there were no significant differences among the placental transfusion strategies.
